folderWarnings.rule: A folder mapping outranks a client's own access set: inside a mapped folder, and below it, the gateway uses the folder's set for every client. Order: folder mapping, the client's own set, TOOLPORT_PROFILE, Default access.

steps.detail: bind claude-code-bare to the access set Empty and give it Claude Code's discovery mode

diff.after:
clientScopes.claude-code-bare: empty
clientDiscovery.claude-code-bare: (inherits the global mode)
diff.before:
clientScopes.claude-code-bare: bare
clientDiscovery.claude-code-bare: (inherits the global mode)

plan.summary: Update launch profile bare: Claude Code started with claude-code-bare sees the access set Empty
plan.undo: toolportctl context launch-profile add bare --set bare --deny-direct off
warnings: In <WORLD>/home/proj the gateway uses Wide, not launch profile bare's own set: it adds 2 servers its own set leaves out (alpha, beta). A folder mapping outranks a client's own access set: inside a mapped folder, and below it, the gateway uses the folder's set for every client. Order: folder mapping, the client's own set, TOOLPORT_PROFILE, Default access.
claude-code has no discovery override, so claude-code-bare follows the global mode; the small-catalog Full that claude-code gets under Auto is built into that client id and cannot be copied
